The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SEO, Google Ads, META Ads, LinkedIn Campaigns, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), along with a solid understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page performance. This role requires close collaboration with the Content, Sales, and Design teams and strong communication skills to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and measurable business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute SEO and GEO strategies to improve organic visibility across search engines and generative AI platforms
  • Plan, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search & Display), META (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn to drive lead generation and brand awareness
  • Conduct keyword research, intent analysis, and competitor research using tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, and similar platforms
  • Implement on‑page, off‑page, technical SEO, and GEO best practices, including content structuring for AI‑driven search results
  • Analyze and optimize landing pages and conversion funnels to improve conversion rates and campaign effectiveness
  • Coordinate closely with the Content team to create SEO‑ and GEO‑optimized blogs, web pages, and ad copies
  • Work with the Design team to develop engaging and conversion‑focused creatives for ads and social media
  • Collaborate with the Sales team to align marketing campaigns with lead quality and conversion objectives
  • Manage and grow social media channels, including content planning, publishing, engagement, and performance tracking
  • Track, analyze, and report campaign performance using Google Analytics (GA4) and advertising platform insights
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve ROI, CPL, and overall performance
  • Stay updated with evolving AI search trends, GEO best practices, and digital marketing tools

Preferred Skills

  • 3–6 years of hands‑on experience in Digital Marketing
  • Strong expertise in SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Google Ads, META Ads, and LinkedIn Ads
  • Mandatory understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and landing page performance
  • Experience with Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar SEO and research tools
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4) and performance reporting
  • Experience in social media management and paid social campaigns
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams
  • B2B marketing experience

Application

Interested candidates can share their resume with hr@enfintechnologies.com, mentioning the subject “Digital Marketing Executive (mention your relevant exp in DME)”.
